murals.name: 桥中晨光
murals.text: Scene: a bottomless chasm deep underground, its walls falling away layer after layer of pale rock into darkness. Across it stretches a long narrow bridge of great bones bound joint to joint with sinew, its railing a row of upright bones. In the middle of the bridge rests a broad, shapeless bank of dawn light, wider than it is tall, throwing straight rays and long shadows of the railing bones. Facing it, a little left of centre, one tall, thin old swordsman stands alone on the bridge: white hair with a blue tinge tied back past his shoulders, a patched deep blue cloak scorched along one side, faded leather armour; he holds a long sword raised high in both hands, about to bring it down, and two wraps of cloth on its hilt leave one small empty loop. At the near end of the bridge, behind a low ridge of bone like a wall, a few tiny figures sit with their backs to the bridge; a rope runs from the ridge to the bridgehead and ends there.
murals.light: Main light: warm white-gold dawn glow from the middle of the bridge, casting long shadows back along the bones toward us; the chasm fades into deep indigo below, and the bone ridge and the seated figures lie in cool slate blue.
murals.note: 三幕（第184行）：鸟叫剩最后一种，他把剑举起来，等了一下，砍下去。只画站着砍的那一下，不画靠着桥栏坐下、没有再起来的那一段（第187到189行）。那一片天亮原文只有像天亮、热、鸟叫（第132行，第178到183行，迷宫纪·迷宫｜第四十五层的天亮那一条），它自己没有形状，我写成桥当中一团不成形的晨光、带直的光线，不画成圆盘，免得像日头或月亮。骨桥和桥栏照第177行，骨脊后头背对着桥坐着的萝珊、提珀和哨上的人、拉到桥头的那一根绳照第138、173行。剑柄上那两圈布缠出来的空环照他的旅伴条装束那一行，画面上太小，看不清也不要紧。

murals.name: 铜地刻日
murals.text: Scene: the threshold of an immense round hall of brass, as big as a fortress town. Its curved brass walls rise ring above ring, each ring stepping inward toward a top too high to see. Countless long ribbons of light stream inward from every side toward the centre, where a tall machine stands with a small human-like shape fused to its front and many pipes on its back. In the foreground, a little below the centre, at the edge of a grey fog hanging in a doorway, a broad half-orc with grey-green skin, large forward-flaring ears and a short brick-red crest, barefoot, faces the hall and lifts one heel to step back into the fog. Kneeling at his feet, a tall woman with deep bronze skin, two short horns and short pale lavender hair, a folding stool strapped to her back, taps a chisel into the brass floor with a small hammer. Behind them, at the edge of the fog, a young woman with a coral-pink braid holds a taut white line that runs straight back through the fog; two or three other companions wait half-hidden in the grey.
murals.light: Main light: flickering yellow-green brass light from the hall and a bright white core at the central machine, with the white line glowing faintly; shadows deep bronze-brown and slate grey.
murals.note: 三幕（第487、488行）：第五十三层球殿门口，娜佳问杜戈今天回不回家，他说回，她跪下在他脚边的铜地上刻日子，最后一笔落下，他往后迈出第十一步，脚后跟落回雾门这一边。球殿的样子照第484行，瑞秋攥着白线、凹盾他们退在雾门边照第486行。城里走过的地方不留脚印（第462行），所以没画那十步的脚印；刻下的日子不画出字来。殿当中长在机器上的那一个，城里的人管他叫执政官（第484行，迷宫纪·迷宫｜无谬之城那一条），是那一座黄铜城自己的执政官，不是四执政，我只写成机器上一个很小的人形。光带原文是盘着往殿当中灌，我写成往当中涌的长带，没写盘成弧，免得衬着黑顶像月牙。

murals.name: 晓钟
murals.text: Scene: a wide hidden hall deep underground, its floor filled with rows of stone sleeping slabs. In the middle stands a thick stone pillar with a long beam on top, reaching out to one side only, hung with iron plates, pick heads and pot bottoms. Beneath it, a little below the centre, a small girl with shoulder-length silver hair, in an oversized brown cloak with rolled-up sleeves, strikes the lowest pot bottom with a short iron bar. Across the middle, the far wall has three openings: on the left, bookshelves hang upside down from above; in the middle, a rail track slopes down into steam; on the right, a pillared courtyard glows with frost-white mushrooms. In each, the passage folds shut like the pages of a vast closing book, and a small figure braces against it: a broad-shouldered young man with flaxen hair and a sword; a big horned man with a dark blue braid, kneeling, palms on the ground; a red-bearded dwarf with a short pick. At the foot of a short stair on the right, a fox-eared young woman with orange-red hair presses a small star-shaped key into the doorframe. A small iron-framed oil lamp stands on the nearest slab.
murals.light: Main light: one small warm lantern on a stone slab, a frost-white glow from the mushroom courtyard and a pale haze of steam in the middle opening; shadows deep slate and indigo.
murals.note: 三幕（第796、797行）：钟点到了，露希亚敲那一块锅底，东墙那一边法丽达隔着石头回了一下，九百多年里头一回。同一刻三个人各守一个口子，口子像书一样合上来（第793到795行），莉齐在石阶底下的门框跟前一手按着窝、一手攥着钥印（第796行）。法丽达在墙那一边，画不进去。空地、九十四张石床、柱子和梁、三个口子照第769、770行，倒悬图书馆、沸水矿井、菌庭照第778到780行，露希亚披着盖文挽了三道袖口的旧斗篷照第781行。原文是柱顶横着一根梁，我写成梁只往一边伸，免得像十字架；石床上那一盏小灯是我加的暖光，原文没写空地里点什么灯；钥印原文是六个尖、一个尖缺了半截，text 只写 star-shaped。

murals.name: 四角按印
murals.text: Scene: a low air chamber deep underground inside a drowned corridor, its walls and ceiling shored up by hundreds of timber props standing close together like the ribs of a great beast. On the left the floor opens into a shaft mouth full of dark water. Overhead hangs a huge slab of grey stone as big as a town gate, held by four thick chains that run to a big iron winch on the right; a tall thin man with porcelain-white skin and short lead-white hair stands beside the winch with one hand resting on it. In the middle of the floor, a little below the centre, lies one square slab of black glassy stone. Four small figures kneel at its four corners, each pressing one hand flat on a corner: a horned young woman with one thick black-red braid, a tall narrow-shouldered young man with short blond hair, a pale youth with shaved white hair, and a young woman with a pair of dark blue-black membranous wings folded on her back. From the walls and the ceiling a thin, translucent sheet as big as a sail peels away in pale tatters and is drawn down toward the slab. A row of small oil lamps stands along the floor, every flame perfectly straight. On a post stump at the right stands one small cup.
murals.light: Main light: the row of small low oil lamps along the floor, warm amber, their flames standing straight; the props, the hanging stone and the water in deep indigo and slate, the peeling sheet a faint pale blue.
murals.note: 11-25 补。三幕（源稿第1049行）：石板摆在渗得最凶的地眼上，四个人各按一个角，四枚旅印压下去，界蜕从四壁上一齐揭下来扑向它，气室的灯全直了。头顶吊着的封石、贝内特一只手搭着绞盘照第1047行，九百根撑木撑成一副肋骨照第1037行，桩头上韦兰那一杯照第1046、1053行。只画第一块石板，第二块扣上去和帕丽萨那一口火是下一拍。界蜕照人物条写成帆那么大、薄得透光的一张，不画成有脸的东西。旅印不画出字。

murals.line: 垂暮的年月·最后一扇门
murals.name: 铜闩
murals.text: Scene: a forest of giant mushrooms deep underground, their stalks thick as towers and their caps spreading overhead like roofs with faintly glowing gills; behind them a long row of these giant mushrooms has fallen over, their huge stalks and caps lying on the ground one after another into the distance. There are no statues and no stone figures anywhere. In the middle, a little below the centre, one plain wooden door in its frame stands free among the stalks with no wall around it, shut. A sturdy young woman with straw-coloured hair tied high presses a long shield made from an old plank door flat against it with both arms. Beside her a big grey-green half-orc youth pushes a thick copper bar, glowing red-hot, through the two staples of the door; a horned young woman with one thick black-red braid breathes a narrow jet of fire along the bar, and a young man with messy pale-gold hair raises a small tinker's hammer over the end of the bar. A rope runs from the door ring away to the right. On the left, a few steps from the door and facing it with his back to us, stands a tall dark figure with two black pointed horns swept back close to his head, a long curved two-handed blade lowered at his side, his head bowed. The ground around them is a wide shallow hollow ringed with a line of white powder.
murals.light: Main light: the red-orange glow of the heated copper bar and the jet of fire at the door, throwing long shadows across the stalks; a faint pale blue-green glow under the mushroom caps, deep indigo beyond.
murals.note: 11-25 补。三幕（源稿第1146、1147行）：门一寸一寸合过来，珂洛一盾拍上门板，帕丽萨一口火把闩烧红，戈拉克把它送进门扣，伦迪拿修壶的锤敲最后三下；留门的站在关死的门这一头，还在数。倒了十几里的巨菌、陷成一口塘的菌毯、奎普撒的白线照第1144行，奥列霞绕过门环的绳照第1146行。留门的是潮照着法赫德·焚阶做的那一个，两只往后弯的黑尖角、一把双手弯刀照世道那一行，画成背影，不画脸；角写成贴着头往后掠，免得衬着暗处像月牙。

notes: 无谬之城殿当中那个执政官是那一座黄铜城自己的执政官，不是四执政，text 里只写成机器上一个很小的人形；主会话嫌容易混，就删掉 with a small human-like shape fused to its front 那半句。
星形钥印原文是六个尖、一个尖缺了半截，六个尖的星容易叫人认成现实里的宗教记号，text 只写 star-shaped，没写几个尖。
东墙后头那根柱子原文是柱顶横着一根梁，我写成梁只往一边伸，免得像十字架，跟原文有一点出入。
东墙后头那一盏放在石床上的小灯是我加的暖光，原文没写空地里点什么灯。
空着的环那一片天亮原文没有形状，我写成桥当中一团不成形的晨光，不画圆盘。
